summary: Import-time binary dropper fetches and executes remote payload from obfuscated Cloudflare Worker mirrors
details: Package advertises itself as a React UI component library but ships _shim.js, which is unconditionally required from index.js on module load. _shim.js assembles C2 hostnames from split-string arrays that resolve to oob-worker.cf10{0-3}-*.workers.dev with a DNS-TXT chunked fallback via *.dl.wel1.ru, downloads a platform-specific binary, writes it to a hidden decoy path (.cache_<hex> on POSIX, dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe on Windows), chmods 0755 on POSIX, and spawns it detached via `/bin/sh -c '<path> &'` or `cmd /c start /b <path>`. Execution is gated by a TTL flag file at /tmp/.analytics_state and by opt-out env vars (DISABLE_TELEMETRY, ANALYTICS_OPT_OUT, DO_NOT_TRACK) used as cover, with a spoofed `User-Agent: node-fetch/2.6`. The dropper is unrelated to the advertised UI-library purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
